description: Output structure for assent form submissions sent to the CWT API

broad_work_type.description: All assent submissions are S28H Assent casework

detailed_work_type.description: Scheme-specific work type, e.g. 'S28H Assent CS HT'

description.description: Scheme/activities, SSSI names and European site names; unlimited length

consulting_body_type.description: CWT consulting body type derived from the customer type

consulting_body.description: Name of the consulting body or organisation

customer_name.description: First and last name of the person submitting the form

customer_email_address.description: Email address of the person submitting the form

email_header.description: Same content as description, limited to 254 characters

SBI.description: Single Business Identifier; omitted when not provided

agreement_reference.description: Scheme agreement reference number; empty when not provided

public_body_type.description: Category of the public body being represented

public_body.description: Name of the public body being represented

is_there_a_european_site.description: 'Yes' when European sites are affected, otherwise empty

coordinates.description: Format '<e>,<n>' or '<e1>,<n1>;<e2>,<n2>'; empty when not given
